notes: Power Play applies to non-jackpot Powerball prizes. Matching five white balls with Power Play pays a fixed $2 million; the jackpot is not multiplied.
Double Play is a separate drawing using the selected numbers. Its prize schedule is separate from Powerball and Power Play.
Players select eight of 32 teams. The draw uses team symbols; it is not a wager on the outcome of an NFL game.
The jackpot depends on sales. Published prizes can be reduced under the official rules; promotional awards are separate.
Every play has a ticket-specific multiplier of 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X. Published non-jackpot base prizes must be multiplied by that play’s multiplier.
A base-prize table is not a record of actual payments. Snapshot payout counts remain withheld because the source aggregates and multiplier breakdown do not reconcile.
The top two prize labels describe annual payments for life, with a minimum guarantee of 20 annual payments. They are not cash amounts or lifetime totals.
Cash selection and claimant circumstances affect payment options. Consult the official rules; the unresolved numeric life-prize API amounts are withheld.
Some published prize amounts depend on the prize pool and number of winners. Actual drawing payouts can differ from the reference schedule.
A displayed jackpot is not evidence of a claimant payment.
Kicker is an extra number selected for the ticket, not a separately drawn bonus number. When activated, it must match one of the winning numbers for Kicker prizes.
Actual prizes can be lower than the advertised schedule. The report’s Kicker amounts are separate from advertised combined prizes; do not replace or add them to create a ticket total.
Reference prizes use a $1 play without Bonus. Prize values depend on the number of spots and wager. Adding Bonus doubles the ticket cost.
The published maximum is $100,000 without Bonus and $1 million with Bonus. The $1 million prize is subject to split-prize liability and can be reduced.
The saved result is one numbered game with a source date; it is not a live four-minute feed.
Prize schedules depend on wager amount and the selected Straight, Box, pair or combination play. Digit order and repeated digits matter.
Straight/Box splits the wager equally between Straight and Box. A straight win pays both portions. Wild Ball has a separate additional wager and prize schedule.
Report groups overlap. Winning Plays must not be summed into distinct tickets or combined across DAY and NIGHT.
